resources.string: "%1$s no longer supports the old protocol. Please log out and log back in to continue using the app."
"Your homeserver no longer supports the old protocol. Please log out and log back in to continue using the app."
"Step 1/6: Please allow 'install unknown applications', otherwise the plugin cannot be used."
"Step 2/6: You have not installed ntfy and cannot receive message alerts. Now we will install it for you."
"Step 3/6: Please enable the "Notification" permission, otherwise you will not receive message reminders."
"Step 4/6: Unknown malfunction causing you to not receive notifications (please ensure that ntfy is running). Now investigate?"
"Step 5/6: Please allow 'associated startup', otherwise ntfy cannot be launched for you, resulting in you not receiving notification reminders."

"Step 6/6: Please allow ntfy to ignore battery optimization, background residency, and high power consumption. \n Note: Some phones require clicking on the entire line where the button is located to truly enter the interface."
